name: [factory] backlog-label-audit
description: Hourly, capped normalization of legacy issue labels; opt-in via features.backlog_label_cleanup (managed by cezar-factory; do not edit in the cockpit)

task.prompt: Run the bounded legacy-label audit for {{project}} at {{time}} on {{date}}. The only entry point is audit-backlog-labels.ps1. From the Cezar worktree, run exactly once: pwsh -NoProfile -File /projects/cezar-factory/scripts/audit-backlog-labels.ps1. Do not add a resolver, environment-variable interpolation, shell wrapper, fallback path, or retry. If that command fails, stop and report a failed audit. Read only the outputPath emitted by that run; it must be under the current worktree, never the project-root or a prior-run .factory artifact. Copy resolved entries into the result unchanged and only evaluate remaining candidates. Never resolve create-labels.ps1, read or inspect script source, call gh issue list, parse raw issue JSON, search for scripts, reconstruct candidates, or modify source code.
